title: KAN-AD: Time Series Anomaly Detection with Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks

split.decision: std3: each original training series split chronologically at N-floor(0.2*N); prefix for fitting and suffix for validation, each differenced separately. Original evaluation series retained by judge. No random split seed. Raw float64 arrays are bit-equal to source. All 457 curves retained: 8,440,253 fitting points, 2,110,003 validation points, 14,760,632 evaluation points. Opaque IDs and order use a private secrets mapping; no source curve names exposed. UCR validation has no positive events: empty dataset contributes zero with explicit diagnostics.
